metadata.title: Minimality and Nonlinear Spectral Rigidity of Hypersurfaces in Real Space Forms
metadata.abstract: We study nonlinear mean-curvature spectral equations for hypersurfaces in Euclidean, spherical and hyperbolic space. For an admissible analytic response $F$ and ambient sectional curvature $c$, we prove minimality when the spectral parameter satisfies $\sigma\ge nc$, and strict mean-curvature bounds at gradient points when $\sigma<nc$. The class includes every power $F(t)=t^{p-1}$, $p>1$, and positive mixtures satisfying an explicit width condition. In particular, the result proves Chen's conjecture in Euclidean codimension one and biharmonic minimality in constant negative curvature, without completeness or holonomicity. A common real-analytic continuation and focal-trace argument treats all three geometries. Explicit umbilical models show that the unconditional spectral minimality range is sharp. Independently, we prove quantitative local rigidity, modulo ambient isometries, of compact nonminimal geodesic spheres in all three geometries and proper equal-radius Clifford hypersurfaces in spheres, for smooth laws with $F,F'>0$ near the model amplitude.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 非线性谱方程与超曲面极小性
analysis.workSummary: 研究诱导度量下 J_X(Φ(τ)ν)=σΦ(τ)ν，其中 τ=nH。对正实解析 F，其对数导数 R_F 有正上下界并满足 R_F−tR_F′>0，作者证明 σ≥nc 时极小；p>1 的幂律均适用，p=2、σ=0 给欧氏及负常曲率双调和超曲面极小性。σ<nc 的非 CMC 分支有明确 H 界，非极小全脐例子表明无附加假设的谱边界尖锐；另对整个紧模型的 C⁴ 小法向图给模等距的 H⁴ 缺陷控制。
analysis.breakthrough: 若论证成立，将在无需完整性或 holonomicity 的条件下推进双调和超曲面极小性。
analysis.limitations: 固定域 p-bienergy 与使用 p-tension 的替代定义不同。函数可容许性和局部模型 F,F′>0 条件须分别核对；谱边界尖锐不代表非 CMC 曲率界也最优。
